title: DJIA Market Happenings For Tuesday, January 8, 2018
text:
DJIA Market Happenings For Tuesday, January 8, 2018 Posted by admin on January 8th, 2019
There are no Dow stocks at 52 week highs. There are no Dow stock 52 week lows.
The Market
Premarket today, the Dow was indicated to open up +201 points.
Monday the Dow was up +98.19 (+0.42%) at 23,531.35.
Year-to-date the Dow is up +0.87%.
There were 22 Dow stocks up Monday.
The Dow stock winners Monday were led by Home Depot (HD) +1.97%, Visa (V) +1.80% and Nike (NKE) +1.43%.
The Dow stock losers Monday were led by Coca Cola (KO) -1.30%, Merck (MRK) -1.10% and Johnson & Johnson (JNJ) -0.64%.
IBM (IBM) was over 1% higher after it signed a multi-year managed services agreement valued at $540 million with Helsinki-based Nordea Bank.
Dow technology stocks AAPL, CSCO, IBM and MSFT were advancing before the bell Tuesday.
European stocks are higher and Asian markets ended mostly higher.
The national average price of gasoline is down five-tenths of a cent at $2.232 per gallon.
Earnings Reports .
JPMorgan (JPM) reports earnings on 1/15/2019 before the market open.
UnitedHealth (UNH) reports earnings on 1/15/2019 before the market open.
American Express (AXP) reports earnings on 1/17/2019 after the market close.
Goldman Sachs (GS) reports earnings on 1/16/2019 before the market open.
Today’s Featured Dow Stock
Microsoft (MSFT)
Microsoft (MSFT) is up +0.48% year-to-date. Investors will be looking for positivity from MSFT as it approaches its next earnings report date. This is expected to be January 30, 2019. The company is expected to report EPS of $1.09, up 13.54% from the prior-year quarter.
